resources.string: Use the diary without an account. Entries stay on this device.
An account does not back up your diary. Room entries remain on this device.
Verify your email to link your pilot invitation.

Confirm with your password. Phone accounts require a recent SMS sign-in. Your account and server results will be deleted and all sessions revoked. The local diary stays in this account’s private section. Invitations and limits are not restored.

Move the guest diary and goals into this account and link the invitation? Guest height and weight fill empty profile fields. The account name stays; the original guest profile is retained locally. Conflicting records or values stop the transfer. Guest mode will no longer show moved entries after sign-out. No new AI budget is granted.
Guest linking is unfinished. Sign in to the same account and finish it in your profile. Guest entries are preserved and temporarily hidden.
If this address is eligible, an email with a code has been sent. Check your inbox and spam folder.
Password changed. Sign in with the new password.
Could not sign in. Check your email and password.
Session expired. Sign in again. Your local diary is preserved.
Too many attempts. Wait before trying again.
The code is invalid, expired or already used.
The server could not deliver the email. Try again later.
Sign in again before linking or deleting a phone account.
Data conflicts. Automatic merging was not performed.
The guest session or invitation is invalid.
Could not connect to the server. Check your connection and try again.
Signed out on this device. The server is unavailable; server-side revocation is unconfirmed.
